title: Заморозить release-acceptance contract и exact claim/evidence matrix
summary: Создать единственный нормативный release-acceptance contract и exact machine-readable matrix, связывающую каждый P1 guarantee/non-guarantee, support row, semantic/API claim и release subject с его текущим evidence owner.
why: Набор зелёных phase receipts не доказывает, что публичные обещания полны, непротиворечивы и относятся к одним bytes; P10 нельзя сводить к общему CI status. `RAG:—` в `@plan/knowledge/research-P10-design.json`.

include: Private/public acceptance axes; closed status taxonomy; exact claim and evidence IDs; upstream owner/path/digest relations; P1 threat/guarantee/support/resource rows; P2–P5 security/durability receipts; P6 semantic/JCS/MCP namespaces; P7 API/package rows; P8 adversarial/resource rows; P9 subject/SBOM/provenance/capability rows; release-blocker/residual-risk rules; deterministic validator and adversarial fixtures.
exclude: Re-running child suites; changing upstream semantics or receipts; user-facing documentation; consumer execution; risk acceptance; public version/channel/legal choice; tags, uploads or credentials.

rules: Derive the claim set from normative upstream owners; never hand-copy a smaller allowlist. Each row has stable ID, class, owner, evidence path/digest, applicability, freshness, private-blocking and public-blocking dispositions. Closed states distinguish `verified`, `non_applicable`, `baseline_pending`, `capability_unavailable`, `decision_pending`, `failed` and `stale`; only contract-declared states may be non-blocking on each axis. Keep Agentools, JCS and official MCP scenario compatibility separate. Exactly-once external effect, certification and unavailable hosted attestation are forbidden claims. A private PASS never sets `public_authorized=true`.
guidance: Validate JSON structurally and semantically; recompute file digests, exact-set joins and duplicate ownership. Emit machine JSON before rendered Markdown. Fixtures must cover missing/extra/stale evidence, wrong subject digest, collapsed capability state, unclassified residual, false MCP certification and a private PASS incorrectly reused as public authorization.
deliverables: `release-acceptance-v1` contract/schema, exact digest-qualified acceptance matrix, deterministic validator and human finding ready for documentation and final dossier work.

result.notes:
